narrative.northStar: Real media first, clear controls around it
narrative.overview: A deep navy editing workspace with overhead light, violet actions and the supplied Zura mark. Source, look and prompt sit beside the real preview; shot settings and the next action remain together.

rules.name: Honest progress
rules.body: Never present a current-stage percentage as whole-job completion. Show measured remaining time as an estimate.

dos: Retain native audio, masking and graph controls
donts: Do not fabricate previews or results
Do not imply unavailable browser verification
